description: Header file defining utility functions for JSON parsing, configuration searching, and testing within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It declares functions for parsing JSON strings, finding configuration elements in string vectors, and launching CVD parser testers, along with including relevant libraries.

methods.name: ParseJsonString
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a Json::Value object.

methods.name: FindConfig
methods.description: Checks if a specified element exists within a vector of strings.

methods.name: FindConfigIgnoreSpaces
methods.description: Checks if a string exists within a vector of strings, ignoring spaces.

methods.name: LaunchCvdParserTester
methods.description: Launches a test for the CVD parser based on provided JSON configuration.
